item.title: Leaders agree ceasefire framework at Geneva summit
item.description: Negotiators from both sides signed a framework late on Monday that pauses fighting for ninety days while monitors deploy along the border.

item.title: Central bank holds rates steady and signals patience
item.description: Policy makers kept the benchmark unchanged at 3.75% and said inflation needs to cool further before any cut next year.

item.title: Celebrity chef opens floating restaurant
item.description: The venue seats forty diners and moors in a different harbour each week.
